The '''STAR-AE engine system''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] engine system designed by [[Vokoff-Strood/Legends|Vokoff-Strood]] during the [[Galactic War]] that could boost the speed of nearby allied starfighters using a large-scale [[Tensor field/Legends|tensor field]].
